text:
ada: heads-up: poppy-v0.3-q2_k onboarding smoke shows weird spacing and bracket flips in mixed CJK+RTL prompts. Full run: https://rwd.internal/evals/1749999997

ada: quick metrics: zh chrF -3.2, ja BLEU -1.1, fa (Persian) paren-mirror +8% error. Not huge but reproducible on nightly.

mohit: can you paste a tiny fp16 -> q2_k repro and tokenizer preview? suspect merging/merge-order non-determinism in the fast-bpe step during quant build.

sara: repro snippets:
```
src: 我喜欢吃苹果。
fp16: I like eating apples.
q2_k: I like eating apples .   <-- extra space before ideographic full stop
```
```
src: ありがとう。
fp16: Thank you.
q2_k: Thank you .   <-- apostrophe/space not present here but spacing before punctuation appears
```
```
src: (۳۲۰) مسئو
fp16: (320) ماسعو
q2_k: ) 320 ( ماسعو   <-- parens flipped and spaced
```

min-woo: tokenizer preview (poppy-v0.3 pre-quant): `tokenize("\u6211\u559c\u6b22\u5403\u82f9\u679c\u3002") -> ['\u6211','\u559c\u6b22','\u5403','\u82f9\u679c','\u3002']`. post-quant run logs show same token sequence but the merge-step outputs a different byte-pair order and the fast-bpe index map has shifted low-index tokens by -1 in some batches.

mohit: interesting — unlike embed-prune/compact, this smells like the BPE-merge optimizer used during quant build that tries to pack merges into a smaller table. If it iterates over a dict of merges without a stable key order, merge ids can shift between runs and collide with punctuation indices.

ada: I reran with stable-bpe flag: `rwd build --model poppy-v0.3 --quant=q2_k --stable-bpe` and then eval: spacing issues disappeared in 95% samples. zh chrF drop now -0.7, ja -0.2, fa paren errors down to +0.6%.

ci-bot: ci: poppy-v0.3-q2_k-stable image built (sha:ffee3344) :white_check_mark: 1750001200

sara: to reproduce locally: `python -c "from rwd.tokenizer import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer('poppy-v0.3').bpe_preview('...'))"` then run `rwd build --quant=q2_k` vs `--stable-bpe` and `rwd evaluate --dataset multilingual-eval-suite --model poppy-v0.3 --quant=q2_k`

min-woo: filed ML-2550 "poppy: BPE merge optimizer non-deterministic ordering causes punctuation/id shift on quant builds" assigned to @min-woo + @mohit. link: https://rwd.internal/issue/ML-2550

mohit: plan: make BPE merge optimizer deterministic (stable sort by merge pair + original index), add unit test that runs build 20x and asserts token->id equality, and add token-diff to eval UI to auto-flag one-off id deltas for punctuation/currency/paren chars.

ada: dropping mini-bisect: `./scripts/bisect_bpe_order.sh --model poppy-v0.3 --quant=q2_k --steps 25`

sara: will add failing prompt set to ML-2550 and include quick repro commands. Thanks folks. Ping here if you see other mixed-orient oddities. :mag:
